native_context: Background job actor, tenant and delayed authority
taxonomy_note: Planning compatibility lens only. Classify the final observed root cause independently; unsupported mappings stay unassigned.

controls.boundary: Background job actor, tenant and delayed authority — authoritative consumer
controls.source_trace: Read enqueue, worker, job-status and result-download code together. Record requester identity, resource references, service credentials, grant lifetime and the policy for revoked membership.
controls.controlled_verification: Queue an A-owned export referring to private synthetic B data. Determine whether the worker re-establishes the caller's permitted resource set or trusts a supplied tenant/user field. Separately inspect whether A can read B's existing job/result. For revocation, use the product's declared enqueue-time versus execution-time grant rule.
controls.false_positive_discriminator: A privileged worker is normal architecture. Job acceptance without forbidden consumption is not an export leak. A policy intentionally granting an immutable snapshot must not be labeled stale authorization solely because membership later changes.
controls.remediation_acceptance: Bind requester, referenced objects and result owner; enforce the declared grant lifetime at consumption. Retest result URLs/status as well as the job action and legitimate delayed processing.

coverage_unit: One primary investigative assertion for this technique; not exhaustive coverage. Expand only for genuinely distinct policy/effect assertions in the actual assessment.
